title: ReState: Noise-Level-Aware State Correction for Training-Free Object Removal in Few-Step Diffusion Models
title_zh: ReState：面向少步扩散模型的无训练目标移除——一种感知噪声水平的状态校正方法

paragraphs.en: ReState 是一种无训练目标移除方法，通过感知噪声水平的权重进行状态校正，改善了少步扩散模型的目标移除效果。 Training-free object removal commonly redirects self-attention away from the target region, but on few-step distilled diffusion models this often leaves object-shaped residuals. We identify a temporal mismatch: a structured prediction forms inside the mask at the first forward, and the short trajectory offers few later chances to revise it, while attention rerouting acts mainly in later steps. Across four distilled backbones, magnitude-matched single-forward interventions show that background-directed state correction affects the final result more than attention rerouting. We therefore propose ReState, which corrects the masked clean prediction toward background evidence retrieved from the input using a noise-level-aware weight that vanishes at the final forward. ReState retains object-excluding attention as a complementary constraint and adds no denoiser evaluations. Across two paired benchmarks and two few-step backbones, ReState achieves the best masked PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS among training-free methods, improving PSNR by 3.17 dB on average over the strongest baseline. On OBER-Test, it also outperforms the 50-step attention-forcing reference on all three metrics at 6.7x lower latency. The same configuration transfers to two additional distilled backbones without retuning. Project page: https://tdrlee.github.io/ReState
paragraphs.zh: ReState 是一种无训练目标移除方法，通过感知噪声水平的权重进行状态校正，改善了少步扩散模型的目标移除效果。无训练目标移除通常会将自注意力从目标区域转移开，但在少步蒸馏扩散模型上，这常常留下目标形状的残留。 我们识别出一种时间错位：在第一次前向时，掩码内会形成一个结构化预测，而短轨迹只留下很少的后续机会去修正它，同时注意力重定向主要在后续步骤中起作用。 在四个蒸馏骨干模型上，幅度匹配的单次前向干预表明，背景导向的状态校正对最终结果的影响大于注意力重定向。 因此，我们提出 ReState，它利用一个在最终前向时归零的感知噪声水平的权重，将从输入中检索到的背景证据用于校正掩码内的干净预测。 ReState 保留排除目标的注意力作为补充约束，且不增加去噪器评估次数。 在两个成对基准和两个少步骨干模型上，ReState 在无训练方法中取得了最佳的掩码 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS，PSNR 相比最强基线平均提升 3.17 dB。 在 OBER-Test 上，它以低 6.7 倍的延迟在全部三项指标上超越了 50 步注意力强制的参考方法。 相同配置无需重新调参即可迁移到另外两个蒸馏骨干模型。 项目页面：https://tdrlee.github.io/ReState
